capture_target.description: The screenshot capture target: 'window', 'region', or 'output'. Defaults to 'region'.

copy.description: If true, automatically copy the screenshot to the clipboard upon capture.

anchor.description: The anchor position for the floating thumbnail window. Common values: 'top-left', 'top-right', 'bottom-left', 'bottom-right'.

verbose.description: If true, enable verbose logging output.

savedir.description: Custom directory to save screenshots. If empty, shotman uses environment variables $XDG_SCREENSHOTS_DIR or $XDG_PICTURES_DIR/screenshots, or ~/screenshots.

image_editor.description: The command or path to the image editor used for the 'Edit' function. Defaults to 'gimp'.

wayland_display.description: The WAYLAND_DISPLAY socket name to connect to. If empty, uses the default compositor socket.
